title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2610.18792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. translated_title: SEAR：自我进化的智能体机器人
translated_abstract: 前沿语言模型智能体现在能够自主改进机器人：它们编写控制代码、进行测试，并将有效的部分保留为技能和记忆，以供下一个任务使用。我们提出了SEAR（自我进化智能体机器人），这是一个围绕两个核心问题构建的框架与基准测试：智能体是真的在学习，还是只是尝试得更频繁？它所学到的内容在新任务、新模拟器以及真实机器人上是否仍然有效？该框架以三种模式运行智能体：编写成为策略的代码（代码即策略，code-as-policy）、在控制回路中实时行动（智能体即策略，agent-as-policy）、或作为研究者对视觉-语言-动作模型进行微调（自动研究，auto-research）。该基准测试增设了对照实验，以将保留的经验与重复尝试、熟悉任务、特权模拟器状态、更大的计算预算以及运气等因素区分开来。在七个前沿语言模型、330个模拟任务与5个物理任务、累计超过四年的智能体运行时间的实验中，我们重点展示了三个……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: SEAR提出了一个自我进化智能体机器人框架与基准，让语言模型智能体通过“代码即策略”、“智能体即策略”和“自动研究”三种模式自主改进机器人，并通过严格对照实验验证智能体学到的是真正可迁移的经验，而非仅仅来自更多尝试、熟悉任务或运气。
en_tdlr: SEAR introduces a self-evolving agentic robotics framework and benchmark where language-model agents autonomously improve robots through three modes (code-as-policy, agent-as-policy, and auto-research), with controlled experiments verifying that agents acquire genuinely transferable experience rather than benefiting merely from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, or luck.
